title: Riot Squad Bar EDTN Blue Cherry Burst Longfill 30ml
description: Riot Bar EDTN’s Blue Cherry Burst Longfill combines the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the rich, juicy flavour of ripe cherries. This fruity fusion creates an explosion of flavour with each puff, perfect for vapers seeking a bold and vibrant taste profile. The distinct layers of tart berry and sweet cherry provide a refreshing and satisfying vape experience. This vibrant e-liquid concentrate is crafted for vapers who enjoy fruity, refreshing flavours with a full-bodied character. Riot Bar EDTN Longfills offer an innovative approach to e-liquid customisation, allowing vapers to mix and create a 60ml bottle with their ideal nicotine strength. Each longfill contains 30ml of 0mg e-liquid concentrate in a 60ml bottle, designed to be mixed with VG/PG Mixer Kits (sold separately) , which include a choice of nicotine shots and VG boosters. The Apple & Blackcurrant Longfill is suspended in PG for flexible mixing, allowing users to choose either a higher-VG or balanced VG/PG blend depending on their device preference. Mix with freebase nicotine shots for a high-VG blend suitable for sub-ohm devices or with nic salt shots for a balanced MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) experience. Please note: Riot Bar EDTN Longfill e-liquids are designed to be mixed with a VG/nicotine shot solution and are not suitable for direct vaping. How to use Riot Bar EDTN Longfills: 1. Open your longfill eliquid concentrate bottle and pull out the nib. 2. Pour in all 3 bottles included in your chosen Mixer Kit. 3. Reattach the nib back on the longfill bottle and put the lid on. 4. Shake the bottle vigorously for 1 minute. 5. Your eliquid is ready to vape. Riot Bar EDTN Longfill e-liquids require VG and nicotine shots and are not suitable for direct vaping.
